relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: COX2 played an important role in the inflammation in IDD and was specially inhibited by celecoxib

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 release increased significantly in IL-1β-induced NP cell supernatant medium and was effectively alleviated after the treatment of celecoxib-loaded PCL nano fibers

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: the increase of CGRP was abolished in the PCL/2% celecoxib nano fiber group and the PCL/6% celecoxib nano fiber group

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: CHSY3 expression was significantly higher with low-dose celecoxib and lower with high-dose celecoxib

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: the relative expressions of ACAN and Col II mRNA were significantly decreased, and the expressions of MMP3 and MMP13 were significantly increased

key_findings: Low-dose celecoxib-loaded PCL fibers maintain physiological PGE2, lower CGRP in DRG and reverse IDD in rabbits.
CHSY3 is required for low-dose celecoxib to alleviate IDD (CHSY3-/- mice lose the effect).
